privacy.urlPolicy: The Google tag loads only after a visitor grants analytics consent on the production hostname. Configured page location and referrer omit query strings and fragments. Custom events send only public artwork IDs, series slugs and language codes; advertising signals stay disabled.

collectionRule: Do not load Google Analytics until the visitor explicitly allows it. Declining must keep collection disabled, and the footer must provide a persistent way to revisit the choice. Version 2 asks visitors to consent again to the expanded page-view and gallery-interaction measurement.
qualityControls: One config/page view per document, even after repeated consent or withdrawal and re-consent.
No collection on localhost or preview hosts.
Consent withdrawal disables custom events immediately, including across tabs.
